title: Hash-addressed logical attention head projections
task: Distill fixed four-head teacher attention on sequences of eight real-valued token features (D=32, head_dim=8) into matched student architectures; fixed teacher output readout predicts a 32-way token distribution.
hypothesis: A single physical hashed Q/K/V table plus per-head Givens input Views can recover useful four-head behavior at lower actual bytes than independent heads and improve teacher KL over native tied/salted hashing and MQA/GQA without losing head diversity.
teacher: Four independently initialized Q/K/V head projections, shared frozen output readout; teacher parameters and exact generator are deterministically reconstructed from paid seed and not part of student inference payload.
controls: native GQA with four query heads and two K/V groups
native MQA with four query heads and one K/V group
ordinary tied hashed Q/K/V projections with one map per role
shared hashed Q/K/V tables with per-head deterministic hash salts
shared hashed tables plus per-head 16-angle Givens input Views
shared hashed tables plus per-head diagonal input gates
shared hashed tables plus per-head rank-one Q/K/V residuals
mirror_coordinate: Four head-specific 16-angle adjacent-pair Givens transforms over 32-dimensional token features before shared hashed Q/K/V projections.

hashing.maps: Uniform indices and independent +/-1 signs generated by NumPy PCG64; seed metadata charged in NPZ; indices reconstructed deterministically.

training.loss: Cross entropy from teacher softmax distribution to student logits, averaged across positions (teacher KL differs only by constant).
training.initialization: Same teacher and readout per world across methods; matched student initialization within method; Givens identity, diagonal one, rank-one small Gaussian.

development.selection: No tuning grid; architecture, schedule and thresholds frozen.

fresh.open_rule: Only if both development worlds meet every frozen quality, bytes and head-diversity gate.

storage.authority: actual serialized inference NPZ bytes after load-and-evaluate roundtrip
paid_objects: all Q/K/V table or projection tensors
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Only teacher data and hash maps regenerated from paid seeds and committed code; all student state is serialized.

report: hash lookup and Givens operation counts

primary_metrics: teacher-to-student cross entropy / KL by position
success_gate: Both dev worlds: Mirror teacher KL <= independent-head KL +0.02 nat/token, improves KL over tied/salted hash and MQA by >=0.01 nat/token, uses <=0.75x independent-head bytes and <=1.05x salted-hash bytes, and mean pairwise head-output cosine is at least 0.05 lower than tied-hash without exceeding independent-head KL by >0.02.
failure_gate: Any quality, bytes or diversity gate miss is FAIL; fresh stays sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic teacher distillation only; not language modeling or natural-token NLL
Head count is not independent capacity
Fixed-update optimization is not near-convergence capacity
CPU timings are implementation diagnostics, not optimized-kernel claims
student_initialization: Independent student Q/K/V weights use random initialization; no teacher tensors are used to initialize student weights.
